value.notes: First probe run. Checking movement, dash recharge (should show Dash 5 after dash, ready after 6 ticks), pause ignoring same-tick input, enter resumes. Next: check score/time bonus, spikes, enemy contact, dialog buttons, pause during dash-cooldown.

Run 1 (seed 1) looked consistent: dash sets cooldown 5 and HUD matches, bump on wall ok, pause freezes state and ignores same-tick move, Enter resumes. Next probe: spikes at (3,3) via down,down,right,right to check spike damage, score floor at 0, and HUD after hit. Then enemy contact, dialogs, Restart, and the score/time bonus at the exit. Budget is tight, so keep runs short.
Run 2 showed score 65136 after spikes with score 100 (should floor at 0). Suspect underflow: 0 - 500 wraps to 65036. Confirming with minimal 4-token path to spikes at (3,3) from score 0.

Found one confirmed bug: spikes subtract 500 points from a score of 100 and the score wraps to 65136 (unsigned 16-bit underflow) instead of flooring at 0. Reproduced in run 2 and run 3 (seed 1, 4 tokens). The 4-token path is the shortest possible because spikes at (3,3) are 4 Manhattan steps from the start. Budget is nearly spent, so I stopped here without exploring further mechanics (dash, pause, doors, enemies, gates, timer, dialogs).

reports.title: Spikes make score wrap around to 65136 instead of flooring at 0
reports.observed: After collecting a coin (score 100) and then stepping on spikes at (3,3), score becomes 65136 (100 - 500 wrapped around) and lives drop 3 -> 2.
reports.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but score never goes below 0, so score should be 0 after the spike hit (100 - 500 floored at 0).
